dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, high-intensity perimeters with sharp gradients against the dark dermal background; centers remain low-intensity, matching the primary skin tone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily scattered across the lower-lateral quadrant and upper-right periphery.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent central macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral; a secondary triad of centroids in the upper-right forms a scalene triangle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Exposure of high-intensity pink/red pixels on the far-left perimeter indicates a localized lesion or abrasion; a distinct, thin, horizontal high-intensity linear feature is present in the lower-left-central area.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible overlapping/intersecting geometry between adjacent macro-annuli creates a complex topological chain pattern.
